flags.message: While checking the companion petition cited in the cert petition (Johnson v. Continental Finance Co., No. 25-34), `fedcourts query --court scotus --docket-number 25-34 --decided-before 2025-11-07` returned no row because the companion docket had not resolved by 2025-11-07. A follow-up `fedcourts query --court scotus --docket-number 25-34 --decided-before 0` returned the companion case row (`scotus/73272764`), which included a post-cutoff disposition (`date_decided: 2026-05-07, disposition: dismissed`). No post-cutoff information about the target case (`scotus/73277388`) was accessed, and the companion docket's post-cutoff disposition was disregarded in forming the prediction.
